events.text: Stopped optimizing for agent count; adopted quality-first Core Agent policy.
Focus narrowed to evidence-based research on how to build and improve AI agents.
New-agent creation now requires a proven capability gap and independent evaluation.
Improvement order set to data/context → eval → skill → tool → routing/memory → new agent last.
Added honesty-centered quality gates: verified fact / claim / inference / hypothesis / forecast / unknown.
Confirmed new agents cannot bypass permission, review or production-write boundaries.
